_comment: DRISHTI protected AWS adapter — infrastructure descriptor (Prompt 14 Part F, items 3+5). This is the single reviewed source of the intended AWS plane in front of the custom model workloads. It holds KEYS and NON-SECRET config only; no secret VALUES, no credentials. Placeholders <ACCOUNT_ID>/<REGION>/<VPC_ID>/<...> are filled at provision time by infra/aws/adapter/provision_adapter.py or an operator in the Console/CLI. Region default ap-south-1 (matches the retained AWS corpus).
name: drishti-aws-adapter
topology: Catalyst AppSail -> app/predict/adapter.py (signed HTTPS client) -> AWS API Gateway (TLS/throttle/size) -> Lambda|ECS adapter (services/aws-adapter) -> SageMaker (async/realtime) | AWS Batch | Batch Transform -> (only where necessary) read-only PostGIS/pgRouting analytics RDS

usage_plan._auth_note: The API key is ONLY a usage-plan throttling handle. It is NOT authentication (F.4). Authentication is the HMAC signature (X-DRISHTI-Signature over ts|nonce|body) verified in services/aws-adapter/signing.py. Preferred hardening: front the route with a JWT/OIDC authorizer (e.g. Cognito) and mint tokens via Catalyst Connections.

waf.note: attach an AWS WAF web ACL for IP rate-based rules + common-rule-set as the primary rate control.

vpc_config._note: Private subnets only (no public IP). The adapter reaches SageMaker/Batch/S3 via VPC endpoints; it never egresses to the internet. The security group allows egress to the SageMaker/Batch/S3 VPC endpoints and, only where necessary, to the analytics RDS SG on 5432.

lambda._secret_note: The HMAC secret is delivered by reference (DRISHTI_AWS_ADAPTER_SECRET_ARN -> Secrets Manager) and read at cold start with secretsmanager:GetSecretValue; the raw value is never an env var, never committed, never logged.

ecs_alternative._comment: If run as a long-lived service instead of Lambda, use the same image behind an internal ALB in private subnets; identical env keys + execution/task role. Entry: services/aws-adapter/handler.py:create_app (gunicorn).

sagemaker.note: GPU containers are services/gpu-worker/ pushed to a private ECR repo by immutable digest. Real-time only after a measured latency benchmark; async/batch preferred; never SageMaker Serverless for GPU.

aws_batch.compute: GPU (g5/g6) scale-to-zero managed compute; CPU queue for near-repeat/KDE
aws_batch.note: preferred for offline forecasts, backfills and evaluation.

analytics_rds.access: read-only (drishti_readonly role, IAM DB auth preferred)
analytics_rds.note: PostGIS/pgRouting geospatial routing that Catalyst does not provide. Kept PRIVATE — see infra/aws/rds-network-posture.json. Never on the operational CRUD path.

iam._managed_note: VPC ENI management (ec2:CreateNetworkInterface/...) requires Resource '*' and is provided ONLY by the AWS-managed VPC-access policy, so the inline execution policy stays free of '*' resources except read-only actions AWS does not scope.
